newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CRA shares up on result relief.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CRA shares up on result relief.

text.p: Shares in the CRA Ltd side of Anglo-Australian mining giant RTZ-CRA rose in early Friday dealings after the dual-listed entity posted a calendar 1996 net profit toward the higher end of expectations.
"These days...if something comes in at close to where the market felt they're sort of semi-relieved," said AMP Society head of Australian equities Mark O'Brien said.
At 10.30 a.m. (2330 GMT), CRA shares were 13 cents higher at A$19.36 on turnover of 2.7 million shares.
RTZ-CRA, which plans to change its name to Rio Tinto, made a net profit of US$1.096 billion in 1996, down 24 percent from US$1.441 billion in 1995.
"It pretty much has been in line with where people thought that it would be coming in," O'brien said.
ABN AMRO Hoare Govett institional dealer Kevin Massey said the result was in line with his firms' forecast.
"I think there is generally a bit of optimism. You've seen metal prices obviously performing quite well in the short term so it's a bit more enthusiasm I think," he added.
